acceptance.description: Implement approved XmlTextDeclarationFramer/result/declaration and shared IDtdBudget independently of decoder/resolver/DOM; scalar/mapping/source cursor and exactly-once prefix handoff.

Every split proves declared/absent/rejected outcomes, mandatory encoding/version grammar, bounded prefix/carry, incremental live-budget refusal, exact/one-over limits, EOF/locations, cancellation/fault/disposal and owned snapshots.
